title: The model plugin of Qwen4-Exp checkpoints
description: A hybrid decoder over several residual streams (hyper-connections: each block reads a row mixed from the streams and its output is added to every stream by weights of its own) of gated delta-rule layers and gated block-sparse attention (an indexer picks the KV blocks a token reads past its budget), with zero-centred RMSNorms (1 + weight), a mixture of experts with a gated shared expert, and a multi-token-prediction layer the model drafts from. A finished model plugin: its layout (layout.json) composed by the models core it extends (model-template: the serving contracts, the options) from model techniques.

kernels.name: sparse-indexer
kernels.fallback: an indexed attention's blocks scored in torch a token at a time and chosen by Core's topk_blocks (the same canonical choice, slower at long contexts)
